study: M4 small mechanism audit, stable nonzero empirical gaps
scope: Exploratory reused-development diagnostic, no independent confirmation
unit: 600 original questions, all three generations attached

question_bootstrap.strata: outer fold x GSM8K/BBH, all LOSO masks and outcomes resampled jointly

masks.all_questions: all original questions and three held-generation records
masks.two_seed_any_mean_value_gap: two nonheld seeds have nonconstant actionwise reward sums
masks.two_seed_stable_action_pair: some action pair has the same nonzero reward difference in both nonheld seeds
masks.two_seed_stable_selected_pair: M4 minus Ridge is the same nonzero sign in both nonheld seeds
masks.two_seed_selected_M4_ahead: M4 minus Ridge equals +1 in both nonheld seeds
masks.two_seed_selected_Ridge_ahead: M4 minus Ridge equals -1 in both nonheld seeds
masks.two_seed_default_repair_opportunity: global default fails in both nonheld seeds and some one combination succeeds in both

posthoc_masks.three_seed_any_mean_gap: three-seed actionwise mean range is nonzero
posthoc_masks.three_seed_nonzero_selected_mean_gap: three-seed M4 minus Ridge mean is nonzero
posthoc_masks.three_seed_selected_consistent_nonzero: M4 minus Ridge has one strict sign in all three generations
posthoc_masks.three_seed_stable_action_pair: some action pair has one strict sign in all three generations

statistics: Question-cluster paired percentile95 CI. Conditional LOSO accuracy uses selected records. Task-balanced conditional results are separate from pooled support-weighted results.
multiplicity: All subgroup and LOSO results exploratory, no claim of confirmatory p-values
